articulation.label: visit
articulation.alt: visit: /v/ → /ɪ/ → /z/ → /ɪ/ → /t/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /v/: Upper teeth touch the lower lip; add voice.
/ɪ/: Front tongue, a little lower and relaxed.
/z/: A narrow gap near the ridge; add voice.
/ɪ/: Front tongue, a little lower and relaxed.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

sections: Puck visits his aunt and stays overnight. Her doorbell does not work, so he knocks and waits on the doorstep. She opens the door and welcomes him. They have dinner together. Before bed, she shows him where to put his bag and how to turn on the light.
Why does Puck knock instead of ringing the doorbell?
